damage.name: Community damage formula
damage.formula: DMG = (ATK x (Gildong buff + 100%) + Iris buff) x Skill modifier x Crit DMG x (Boss DMG + 100%)
notes: With Ruingaladh in the team, his Nature's Mark (+100% damage taken) doubles the result.
Base power (ATK) is the sum of flat ATK, times (sum of all % values + 100%), times the product of all "x" multipliers.
Skill Effect does not apply to passives or summons.
This is a community formula, not one published by the developer.
